problemVsSolution.headline: Still managing medical shifts on spreadsheets?

problem.title: The Old Way
points: Hours wasted manually checking rest periods and legal rules.
Frantic group texts to find last-minute shift replacements.
Unfair schedules leading to staff burnout and complaints.

solution.title: With Rockilus
points: Complex constraints and legal rules enforced automatically.
Find the perfect replacement in exactly two clicks.
Fair, conflict-free schedules generated in one click.

features.title: Set your own rules instantly
features.description: Get started immediately without waiting for an onboarding specialist. Define your team, coverage needs, and complex healthcare constraints—from legal rest periods to custom staff preferences.

features.title: Generate & publish in one click
features.description: Let the algorithm do the heavy lifting. Generate optimized, conflict-free schedules in seconds. Verify shift equity with built-in stats, and publish the final roster directly to your team's devices.

features.title: Empower your team
features.description: Keep your staff happy and engaged. Allow team members to submit leave requests and availability before the schedule is generated, and easily swap shifts with peers afterward—all directly within the app.

features.title: Handle last-minute replacements seamlessly
features.description: Life happens. When someone calls in sick, use the Replacement Assistant to instantly find the best substitute. See the exact impact of swapping staff on legal constraints and team equity, saving you endless phone calls.

steps.title: Set up team & coverage
steps.description: Add your staff, define your shifts and coverage needs, and input your legal and custom rules.

steps.title: Get team requests
steps.description: Get your team's preferences before generating. Easily manage leave requests and shift preferences.

steps.title: Click "Generate"
steps.description: Let the algorithm resolve conflicts and instantly create an optimized, fair schedule.

steps.title: Publish & manage
steps.description: Share the roster with your team. Handle shift swaps and last-minute replacements on the fly.
